jobCost.caveat: Each cost line shows quantity × rate against tender while the job is still running. RateHistory keeps past rates reproducible; LabourRates holds wages; Freeze cost writes a ProjectCostSnapshot. Per-line status still surfaces gaps — missing labour rates, unapproved wages, or rates changed after the job started.
